entry_points.text: Online query and mask clear have full and constrained builds; default low crash size is zero on narrow builds else max of platform size plus 8MB versus 256MB; current task uses constant or stable percpu read.
Native debug helpers move registers 0-3 and 6-7; disable restores fixed control and clears addresses while active checks global enables; debug-control MSR helpers bypass early generations.

LDT builder derives limit/base/access/granularity with user-readable forced and long mode cleared; GDT read-write and read-only accessors expose per-CPU tables; gate builder splits handler address and empty means both halves zero.
Native GDT/IDT loads, IDT store, and TR load/store are direct privileged entry points for descriptor hardware state.
LDT install is exposed through paravirtual dispatch on base and count; raw processor number comes from per-CPU storage.

exports.text: Native descriptor core installs sized GDT slots and present TSS/LDT descriptors, clears or installs LDT by count, loads and stores GDT/IDT/TR, invalidates with null zero-sized images, and refreshes TLS from thread state.
Arithmetic package gives in-place 64-by-32 divide yielding remainder, quotient helper with remainder out-param, 32-bit multiply and 64-plus-32 add, and multiply-add-divide with multiply-divide form.
Exposes arch DMA ops table, early and normal firmware alloc plus remap and unmap aliases, and a no-op double-fault TSS setup.

hazards.text: Control-register moves forbid compiler reordering under encrypted guests due to nested-exception risk in entry/NMI paths; any other selector faults immediately.
Callers must supply nonzero divisor and fitting quotient with no internal checks; cascade channel has no page entry, output width is build-dependent, and residue uses 16-bit wrap plus one.
TSS limit maintenance warns when preemptible and needs stable per-CPU state; one TR-load variant requires the current base to match the expected read-only mapping before swapping.
Descriptor, percpu, lock, copy, allocator and check helpers live outside this dossier; callers must provide their contracts and failure modes.

invariants.text: Each leaf maps its four groups to result registers in order with full-word widths; unnamed space is reserved. Brand slices run continuously across the three leaves in numeric order.
Counted leaves need at least two entries and at most the inclusive first-to-last span; range helper aligns a selector down to its 64K family base.
Empty versus all-zero LDT descriptions differ in access and presence expectations; clearing installs null base with zero count and an empty request clears the selector.
IDT staging checks the vector fits a byte then records vector, handler and kernel code segment as present interrupt gate; base/limit setters split scalars and static init distributes flag/base/limit.
Built system descriptors start cleared, carry caller extent and address, record kind and present; GDT copy width follows kind and native writers copy full gate or 8-byte descriptors.

DMA selects controller by channel, combines channel with mask/mode, programs page then address bytes with halving on upper channels, stores count minus one, and reassembles residue with doubling; divide updates dividend to quotient and yields remainder.

locks.text: DMA programming is serialized by one spin lock with interrupt state saved on claim and restored on release.

state_machines.text: Breakpoint save returns zero when inactive on hypervisors, else captures control, disables when other bits set, and returns prior value; restore rewrites only nonzero values so zero means nothing saved.
Per-CPU invalid marker gates TSS limit reload: refresh reloads only when marked, invalidation reloads at once with IO bitmap else marks, reload makes the entry available then clears the marker.

structs.text: Extended identification leaf groups stepping/model/family/type plus extended model/family, brand and package type, and two words of virtualization, memory, power, profiling and media signals.
Three leaves each carry four character words; each word is one 4-byte name slice so each leaf adds sixteen bytes.

L1/L2/L3 cache and TLB leaves report entry counts, associativity and geometry split by instruction/data and page size; leaf 2 decode keeps only top validity flags and maps bytes through cache then TLB kinds to capacity or count.

Reliability leaf reserves word one, reports containment, a power sampling scalar, and thermal/frequency/voltage signals; address leaf gives physical/virtual/guest widths plus a wide speculation and cache-maintenance capability set, thread sizing and invalidate limits.

VM control leaf gives revision, ASID count, page-logging and nested-paging/interrupt/timer controls; confidential-memory leaf gives security capabilities, encryption-bit position, guest maximum and identifier floor; protected-memory leaf gives one mode flag and total key count.

Width-hint leaf uses low bits for datapath widths and move preference; sampling leaf packs fetch/execute/counter/branch signals; profiling leaf mirrors OS/hardware availability with control-block and event-record sizing.

Deterministic cache leaf describes one level per subleaf 0..31 with type/level/sharing, zero-based line/part/assoc and sets, plus inclusivity; extended topology gives APIC and node identity; hybrid topology subleaves 0..3 give level width, counts, ranking and APIC identity.

QoS base reports allocation/monitoring support; two leaves size standard and slow-memory bandwidth classes; one leaf gives event count and traffic classes; monitoring leaf gives version/freeze, counter counts, stack depth and active-unit mask.
Extended capability leaf packs nested-breakpoint, fence, paging-lock, selector, mitigation and predictor reports in word one and microcode plus predictor sizes in word two; other words reserved.

Vendor base gives max leaf and name shards; next leaf gives stepping/model/family, revision bytes, frequency and recovery/power flags; companions carry revision identities and string shards; operating-point leaf gives frequency/voltage/share/delay; compat leaf pairs availability with enablement for cipher/hash/crypto/thermal controls.

Generic result holds four register images with index 0..3; known selectors include 5, 13 and 21; parse metadata records entry count and the table currently holds the first two base leaves; one descriptor has fixed 32 TLB entries.

Generic descriptor is packed extent/address plus access/privilege/presence and mode/granularity; system descriptor adds kind and high address; gate combines offsets with segment/attributes; table register image is packed limit plus address.

Gate kinds are interrupt 0xE trap 0xF call 0xC task 0x5 with TSS 0x9 and LDT 0x2; present is 0x80 and 4K granule 0x8000 with 64-bit data/code templates and access-right encodings; boot IDT has 32 entries; crash align is 16MB; debug control keeps bit 10 set.
Legacy DMA has 8 channels with 4GB 32-bit ceiling; bases 0 and 0xC0, read 0x44 write 0x48; controller command/status at 0x08 and 0xD0 with per-channel address/count/page ports.
